title: Aftermath and Weather
author: Ada Kavanagh
blurb: Cyrus Coldharbour, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
